program_name: Saskatchewan MMIWG Plus Community Response Fund
funder: Government of Saskatchewan and Women and Gender Equality Canada
amount_notes: Up to $40,000 per project. Total pool $800,000. Half funded by Women and Gender Equality Canada.
organization_types_eligible: Organizations serving Indigenous women, girls, Two-Spirit+ people in Saskatchewan
Community organizations focused on MMIWG awareness and response
eligibility_criteria: Projects must focus on awareness, safety and empowerment for Indigenous women, girls, Two-Spirit+ people
Must serve families and communities of MMIWG+ in Saskatchewan
Must align with MMIWG+ awareness or community response mandate
exclusions: DOES NOT APPLY to Emerge Academy: Program exclusively serves Indigenous women, girls, and Two-Spirit+ people. Emerge Academy serves male youth under 15.
notes: NOT APPLICABLE to Emerge Academy — explicitly serves Indigenous women, girls, Two-Spirit+ people only. Emerge Academy is male youth U15. Include in database for other clients but exclude from Emerge Academy matching. Rolling intake until funding allotted.
